name: r14-f2-ldg256-ef-el-ilv
author: solx-loop
description: Built from harness measurements. A call costs a fixed 1.5 us (empty kernel). After that, time is set by cold DRAM reads competing with write-backs of the flush's dirty L2 lines, plus CTA dispatch. So: one launch of small low-register CTAs (16 per SM, LDG.256, one row per half-warp), evict_first loads, and evict_last stores on this call's own outputs, so the L2 keeps our outputs rather than the flush's lines (M -20%, L -3%). Q/K-interleaved CTA order for B*S <= 256. Ties the current best at M/L;
